Subject: Validation needed for PO hold: W-8BEN-E and foreign tax ID evidence

Hi Alejandra —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. We're ready to move Nimbus Payments to PO issuance but the vendor onboarding queue flagged a gap in tax evidence for non-US entities. To clear the PO hold we need the following items from you: 

- Completed and signed W-8BEN-E (signature/date required).
- Official tax ID certificate or equivalent issued by Mexican tax authority (SAT) showing the RFC for Nimbus Payments S. de R.L. de C.V. — a stamped PDF or certified copy is fine.
- If the signatory on the W-8BEN-E is not the legal representative listed on the RFC, a letter of authorization is required.

Attached is the PO request reference (PO-REQ-4827) — once we have the documents above finance will finalize vendor classification and issue the PO. If you prefer, you can send documents via DocuSign link (we can generate) or upload to the Drive folder linked below.

Goal: complete evidence by EOD Wednesday (2027-06-02) for a target PO issuance on Thursday. Let me know if that timeline works or if you need support with notarization/translation details.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Jordan / Alejandra —

Received the attachments, thanks for the quick turnaround, Alejandra. A couple of compliance checks from Finance before we can finalize: 

1) The signer mismatch: we need either (a) a notarized letter of authorization on company letterhead confirming Alejandra Ruiz can execute tax/finance forms OR (b) a recorded board resolution naming the signatory. A scanned, signed and stamped PDF is acceptable for initial verification; Finance may request originals later.

2) RFC certificate must clearly show the legal entity name and RFC value. The copy you sent looks fine but the file name on our side is low-resolution; could you provide a higher-res PDF or the SAT-issued PDF export if available?

3) If your RFC uses diacritics/abbreviations, please include the exact spelled legal name you want on the Redwood PO (this controls where invoices are paid).

If you can provide items 1 and 2 by tomorrow morning (2027-06-02 10:00 PT) we can proceed. If translation or notarization will delay you more than 48 hours, let us know and we'll propose a conditional PO workflow with limited payment terms.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Finance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
